title: Tomato - Tomato Yellow Leaf Curl Virus
text: Tomato Yellow Leaf Curl Virus causes leaves to curl upward, yellowing, stunting, and fruit set issues. It spreads via whiteflies.
symptoms: Leaves curl upward, yellowing of margins, stunted growth, reduced fruit set.
management: Use resistant varieties, remove infected plants, control whiteflies with sticky traps or insecticides.
prevention: Plant resistant varieties and control vector populations.

title: Cherry - Powdery mildew
text: Powdery mildew appears as white powdery spots on leaves, especially on young growth. Over time leaves can distort and drop.
symptoms: White powdery coating on leaves and shoots, leaf distortion, premature defoliation.
management: Prune to improve airflow, apply fungicides labelled for powdery mildew.
prevention: Use resistant cultivars, avoid overhead irrigation, maintain canopy airflow.
